entities.name: Sazō Idemitsu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sazō Idemitsu  was a Japanese businessman and founder of the petroleum company Idemitsu Kosan. He graduated from Kobe University. He was also an art collector, especially fond of Sengai Gibon and of Georges Rouault. He is the father of the Japanese experimental video artist, Mako Idemitsu.
